content.scenario: The National Commission is hearing a case involving a large number of consumers who have been affected by a defective product. The Commission forms an opinion that it involves the larger interest of consumers and directs a consumer organization to assist the Commission in the case.
content.outcome: The consumer organization will assist the National Commission in the case, providing expert opinion and evidence to help the Commission make a decision in the larger interest of consumers. The Commission may also direct the organization to assist in the implementation of its order.
